posts.cooked:
A new year, a new conspiracy theory.

Ever since I saw the promo for GI Bunker, I've been wondering who was in that suit.  See- I have this theory that the fates of the Bunker pilots are intertwined, and I think that each of the pilots are funhouse reflections of one another.

First- we have the upstanding Tyler Vance.  He's the very definition of heroic. He's honest, upstanding, heart of gold, keeps going no matter the odds, and makes the ultimate sacrifice (in Iron Legacy's timeline) to fight evil.  

Second, we have Stephen graves- the envious rival who becomes more and more twisted and grotesque as his jealousy (and consumption of chemical enhancements) grows.  Despite this, he eventually reforms and becomes a hero when the person he was competing with dies fighting evil.  

Basically, we have two patterns that are in play- the hero and the reformed villain .  And here's where it gets interesting. 

Who is GI Bunker?

I don't think that its a random person.  I think that we've already met the pilot.  I think....its Chairman Pike.  

We know that Pike is old enough to have fought in the war and he's got distinctive facial characteristics (rockin' the stache) that would make him immediately recognizable even in a 1940's military uniform (or a scientist coat, or the wrecked GI armor).

AND- if it was pike, it would fit with the character pattern established by Tyler and graves.

Tyler is the Hero, Graves is the Reformed Villain, Pike is the Fallen Hero.  It adds a whole new element to his story, and even provides some interesting new angles.  Maybe he started the organization as a way to tame the rampant Crime in Rook city, and (over time) became what he was trying to prevent?  Maybe he's always had a rotten core, even when trying to be a hero. Maybe he was crippled in the GI suit, and thats why he began his life extension/body rejuvenation experiments in the first place.

But wait- theres more!

If Pike is the GI suit pilot (maybe even the original DESIGNER of the suit), that opens up an entirely new can of worms for future plot developments.  

Picture this... Pike has been intrinsic to the development of the Bunker project from day 1.  He comes home from the war a hero, and proceeds to build an empire.  Naturally, when the government decides to continue the project, they ask for his input.  Maybe he doesn't take part directly...but he is in the loop the entire time.  

When the government needs specialty parts, you can bet that Pike industries is in the running for that contract!  

What if Bunker's future holds the terrifying revelation that all of his armor has been built and modified- for years- by one of the F5's greatest foes?

What if that foe (who knows EXACTLY how to operate those suits) rigs them for remote operation (using loyal agents, or unwitting pawns)? It could be done under the guise of a legitimate upgrade- since we know that the Bunker suits are in a constant cycle of maintenance and development, and there is a large support crew.

It would complete the plot circle of heroes turning into villains and villains turning into heroes- you have the pilot who always made the right choice being perceived as a villain, and having to fight against his own suits.  

Bunker vs. the Hall of Armor!

Just to nitpick, 3 cards, 2 suits, one ruin of a suit.

I agree he begs for more versions.  I frequently play around with making Custom Promo Card powers, sadly I can't do any art.  But I've come up with 5 Bunker promo card powers that didn't totally suck.

I toyed around with a custom promo that gave him "deal all non-hero targets 1 projectile damage ." as a base power, it got really sick with Turret/Grenade/Flak, since you could mix up damage to fit exactly what you wanted to do.  I didn't like what it did to his mechanics value as much, but it wasn't terrible.  Made him too much like Expat.

Another one I messed around with was "This power cannot be prevented by the effect of a mode card: Search your trash for a mode card and put it into play, if you do you may use a power or draw a card."  That one could make a crappy start worse until you got 2 modes out of your deck, but it also let you use Turret and Recharge Mode very interestingly.  It really rewarded changing modes a lot, it is also longer and more complex than I like a base power to be.  Probably my 2nd favorite one I came up with for him.

Less played ones include:

"reduce all damage dealt to Bunker by 1 until the start of your next turn."  I wanted to include a redrection tanking effect, but it was way too wordy to work, so I dropped it.  Works alright with Turret/Maintenance if you want to highest HP tank, or if you just have nothing else to do on your power phase.

"Deal one target 1 lightning damage, untill the start of your next turn reduce damage dealt by that target by 1."  My favorite one, because it is a Mech Taser (ok not really)!  Seriously Fright Train+Bunker is an Elemental.

"Insert DW Expat's power here"  It was nice if you were really set up or just had GGun in play, otherwise it kind of sucked.  Just wanted to try it after playing DW Expat.  This doesn't really count as coming up with a power, but whatever.  

I also had a "Deal one target 2 irreducible damage" power, but when GI Bunker came out it got ditched, Panzerbuster is a much better base power.
